title: Localize, Then Reason: Visual Latent Structural Reasoning for Molecular Properties and Edits
abstract: arXiv:2608.13244v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Local chemical perception and property reasoning are both essential for understanding how molecular structure determines properties. Current LLM-based chemical reasoning methods either receive SMILES/molecular images together with descriptions of local motifs, or reason directly from molecular images. Neither approach enables the model to focus on chemically meaningful regions before reasoning. To address this gap, we propose Visual Latent Structural Reasoning (VLSR), an end-to-end framework that jointly learns localization and reasoning from molecular images. Central to our approach is a localize-then-reason strategy. VLSR first learns to locate chemically meaningful regions in a molecular image. It then reasons about their property effects in a compact latent workspace before producing the final answer. Under the same inference setup, this design achieves 9.6X higher throughput than a comparable textual-reasoning baseline.

translated_title: 先定位，后推理：用于分子性质与编辑的视觉潜在结构推理
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13244v1 公告类型：新 摘要：局部化学感知和性质推理对于理解分子结构如何决定性质都至关重要。当前基于LLM的化学推理方法要么接收SMILES/分子图像以及局部基序的描述，要么直接从分子图像进行推理。这两种方法都无法让模型在推理前聚焦于化学上有意义的区域。为解决这一差距，我们提出了视觉潜在结构推理（VLSR），一种端到端框架，联合从分子图像中学习定位和推理。我们方法的核心是“先定位后推理”策略。VLSR首先学习在分子图像中定位化学上有意义的区域，然后在紧凑的潜在工作空间中推理其性质效应，最后生成最终答案。在相同的推理设置下，该设计实现了比可比较的文本推理基线高9.6倍的吞吐量。
tldr: 本文提出VLSR框架，采用“先定位后推理”策略，从分子图像中联合学习化学区域定位和性质推理，显著提升推理效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the VLSR framework with a localize-then-reason strategy, jointly learning chemical region localization and property reasoning from molecular images, achieving significantly higher inference throughput.
